ZOLLER: Technology and commitment
to greater sustainability

columns.header: ZOLLER helps you achieve your sustainability goals by reducing waste, minimizing energy consumption, and increasing the efficiency of your production processes.

columns.body:
Sustainability plays a central role in ZOLLER's corporate philosophy. We stand not only for economic success, but also for environmental and social responsibility. Our entire portfolio of solutions for presetting, measuring, inspecting, balancing and shrinking cutting tools, as well as the software, interfaces, cloud services, and solutions for automating cutting tool processes in manufacturing helps to conserve resources. We are socially committed and offer fair working conditions and practices in our company.

The integration of sustainable practices into our business processes is of crucial importance to ZOLLER. We are aware that our activities have an effect on the environment and place great emphasis on resource-saving technologies and energy-efficient production methods. By using environmentally friendly materials and optimizing our logistics, we actively contribute to reducing our ecological footprint. We also promote a corporate culture that places sustainability at its core. Our employees are trained and motivated to make sustainable decisions and contribute innovative ideas to improve our environmental footprint. We believe that every individual can contribute to making our company fit for the future. We see the 17 Sustainable Development Goals from the United Nations' Agenda 2030 as the guideline for our own sustainability efforts.

ZOLLER also assumes social responsibility. We support local communities and use fair working conditions. By upholding ethical standards in our supply chain, we ensure that our partner companies also operate sustainably. Overall, sustainability is not just a trend for ZOLLER, but a long-term goal. We are convinced that acting responsibly not only helps to protect our environment but also strengthens the trust of our customers and increases our competitiveness. Together with our partners and customers, we are working to shape a sustainable future - for our company and for future generations.

columns.header: A team from 24 nations at our headquarters in Pleidelsheim

columns.body:
ZOLLER is an innovative company that is characterized not only by its technological excellence, but also by its strong commitment to sustainability and diversity. We attach great importance to creating a working environment in which diversity is seen as a strength.

With employees from 24 different nations, the ZOLLER headquarters in Pleidelsheim promotes a culture of mutual respect and intercultural exchange. This diversity contributes significantly to creativity, innovation, and problem-solving skills as different perspectives come together. Through targeted initiatives and an open corporate culture, ZOLLER sets a standard for social responsibility and sustainable growth both ecologically and socially. In this way, the company demonstrates that sustainable development can go hand in hand with a diverse workforce to create forward-looking solutions together.

Our international workforce is proof that diversity at ZOLLER is not just a goal, but a lived reality - a strength that drives us forward every day.

columns.body:
Our activities are measurable, verifiable, and ongoing.
We view sustainability as an everyday responsibility.

items.subtitle: Bees
items.text: There are five bee colonies maintained on the ZOLLER headquarters premises by an experienced beekeeper. The presence of bees supports the health of local ecosystems. Bees increase biodiversity by pollinating and attracting other pollinators.

items.subtitle: Usage of reusable packaging
items.text: 100% of our parts were delivered in reusable containers or packaging in 2024. We also use reusable packaging (cloth bags) instead of plastic packaging. Cloth bags are more durable and very reusable compared to bubble wrap made of PE.

items.subtitle: Paperless office
items.text: Thanks to digital processes in ABAS and ELO, we are reducing paper consumption every year. In 2024, consumption was reduced by 25% in relation to the number of employees.

items.subtitle: Green electricity
items.text: Compared to the German electricity mix in 2023, we reduced our electricity consumption in 2024. By using exclusively green electricity, we avoided 404 tons of CO2e emissions.

items.subtitle: Service locations
items.text: ZOLLER has service locations throughout Germany. This results in short travel distances to customers, low travel times and costs, lower emissions and, ultimately, a higher level of customer satisfaction.

items.subtitle: Seed Balls
items.text: We give away seedballs with plant seeds to customers and suppliers. We have already distributed around 1,750 seedballs, creating green surfaces and increasing biodiversity.

to reduce paper consumption.

items.value: Exclusive LED illumination in new building (conversion is being planned in existing buildings)
items.content:
Exclusive LED illumination in new building (conversion is being planned in existing buildings)

as LED illumination consumes significantly less energy and has a longer life. As a result, maintenance costs are also lower. In addition, LED lighting does not contain any harmful substances, such as mercury, and is fully recyclable.

items.value: Green roofs on new buildings
items.content:
Green roofs on new buildings

Green roofs are soundproof, improve thermal insulation, and help retain rainwater. It also provides habitats for plants and animals, thus helping to preserve biodiversity. The microclimate in the area is also improved.

items.value: Waste separation (paper, plastic, residual waste, wood, e-waste and wood)
items.content:
Waste separation (paper, plastic, residual waste, wood, e-waste and wood)

Waste separation helps to conserve valuable raw materials by allowing each material to be efficiently recycled and reused.

items.value: Reforestation around the company premises (35 trees)
items.content:
Reforestation around the company premises (35 trees)

Trees promote biodiversity and improve air quality by filtering pollutants from the air.

items.value: 29 electric car charging stations for employees and customers (in the parking garage)
items.content:
29 electric car charging stations for employees and customers (in the parking garage)

Increasing ZOLLER's attractiveness to customers and employees.

items.value: Use of electric forklifts
items.content:
Use of electric forklifts

Electric forklifts generate no emissions, which improves interior air quality and helps reduce the environmental footprint. They have lower operating costs compared to diesel or gas forklifts, as ZOLLER purchases green electricity and also feeds electricity into the grid through photovoltaics. This also means that less maintenance is required and gas cylinders no longer need to be checked. In addition, electric forklifts are significantly quieter, which contributes to a more pleasant working environment.

items.value: Motion detectors
items.content:
Motion detectors

Water and light are used more efficiently, with consumption only occurring when needed.

items.value: Switch to environmentally friendly all-purpose cleaner Liquid Green for assembly and service
items.content:
Switch to environmentally friendly all-purpose cleaner Liquid Green for assembly and service

Environmentally friendly cleaners contain no harmful chemicals; they consist of natural ingredients that break down easily in the environment and leave no harmful residues. Switching to eco-friendly cleaners can also inspire others to be more environmentally conscious.

items.value: Diesel company vehicles are gradually being converted to electric vehicles
items.content:
Diesel company vehicles are gradually being converted to electric vehicles

There are currently 7 of them, and electric cars do not emit CO₂e emissions while driving, which leads to better air quality and a lower ecological footprint. They are a future-proof investment as they correspond to the increasingly strict environmental regulations.

items.value: Conversion offers also for significantly older measuring machines
items.content:
Conversion offers also for significantly older measuring machines

Only the electronics and possibly the electrical components need to be exchanged. The mechanical component can continue to be used. This leads to higher sustainability and lower energy consumption compared to the manufacture of a new measuring machine. In addition, customer satisfaction increases due to the cost savings achieved.

items.value: ZOLLER technology brings sustainability for the customer
items.content:
ZOLLER technology brings sustainability for the customer

Tools can be sustainably resharpened and ground, and fewer new tools need to be manufactured. This reduces high material costs and the energy required to manufacture new tools.

items.value: Measuring and test equipment is calibrated in-house at ZOLLER
items.content:
Measuring and test equipment is calibrated in-house at ZOLLER

The rolling system has a high savings potential in terms of packaging and shipping.

items.value: Bike leasing offer for employees
items.content:
Bike leasing offer for employees

A job bike can increase ZOLLER's attractiveness and serve as an additional argument in recruitment and employee retention. It has a positive effect on non-wage labor costs. In addition, it promotes environmentally friendly and healthy mobility.

items.value: Operating instructions and manuals are not available in printed form but downloadable for the customer via the MYZOLLER portal
items.content:
Operating instructions and manuals are not available in printed form but downloadable for the customer via the MYZOLLER portal

Reduction in paper consumption.

items.value: VCI bags as a replacement for oils and greases as corrosion protection
items.content:
VCI bags as a replacement for oils and greases as corrosion protection

VCI bags are reusable and recyclable, making them a sustainable choice. They offer long-term corrosion protection. Unlike oil, they do not require any special procedures and leave no residue.

items.value: Trade fair shuttle service by train and bus (included in the exhibitor pass)
items.content:
Trade fair shuttle service by train and bus (included in the exhibitor pass)

Public transport reduces CO₂e emissions and helps to reduce air pollution, as it generates fewer greenhouse gases per person than private vehicles. It is also often safer than cars, as they are controlled by professional drivers and must adhere to strict safety standards. Road traffic is also reduced.

items.value: ZOLLER Garden on the company premises with a dry stone wall and pile of stones
items.content:
ZOLLER Garden on the company premises with a dry stone wall and pile of stones

On the company premises there is an approximately 450 square meter garden with a 45-meter-long dry stone wall and several piles of stones. Employees can spend their breaks in this garden, which helps to reduce stress, promote well-being and strengthen recovery. The dry-stone wall is a valuable refuge for many endangered animal species.

items.value: Digital trade fair reports
items.content:
Digital trade fair reports

Trade fair reports (created with SnapAddy visit report software and automatic thank you e-mail with the required documents sent by business cell phone). Paper consumption is reduced, and customer satisfaction is increased.

items.value: Weighing and measuring food portions in the canteen
items.content:
Weighing and measuring food portions in the canteen

Weighing food makes it easier to estimate the amount ordered, eliminating the need to discard and dispose of food.
